profile.input_contract: JSON Poisson BVP mesh, boundary, and source parameters.
profile.output_contract: JSON BVP solution metrics aligned with pure-stdlib Poisson outputs.
profile.adapter: SciPy-backed Python runner and JSON parser/adapter under SUT/scipy_bvp_poisson_1d/.
profile.dependency_risk: requires SciPy runtime; skipped when unavailable

mrs.description: Superposition / linearity MP_mono: the 1D Poisson equation -u'' = f is linear in the source f. Scaling f by factor > 1 must strictly increase the peak amplitude u_max — analytically by exactly the same factor — even when the integrator is SciPy's adaptive solve_bvp.

explanation_profile.meta_pattern_rationale: Mono MR: Superposition / linearity MP_mono: the 1D Poisson equation -u'' = f is linear in the source f.
explanation_profile.transformation_semantics: Apply ScaleField via transform steps [ScaleField@/source/strength] to derive follow-up input while preserving unrelated fields.
explanation_profile.observable_summary: Observe `u_max` from source and follow-up outputs for MR `scipy-bvp-poisson-source-superposition`.
explanation_profile.predicate_summary: Predicate `greater` / `GreaterThan` checks the expected relation on `u_max`.
explanation_profile.tolerance_summary: Ordinal predicate: no numeric tolerance is applied beyond the declared ordering relation.
explanation_profile.applicability: Applicable when SUT `scipy-bvp-poisson-1d` exposes sample `sample/standard.json`, the transform target fields, and output `u_max`; otherwise not applicable.
explanation_profile.failure_meaning: Failure indicates the SUT output, adapter mapping, or predicate evidence disagrees with the declared metamorphic expectation.

mrs.description: SciPy solve_bvp adaptively refines its own mesh until residual is below tolerance; the user-supplied num_points only seeds the initial mesh. Doubling the seed num_points must leave u_max within tolerance because both runs converge to the same continuous solution u(x)=f·x(L−x)/2, whose peak value u_max = f·L²/8 occurs at x = L/2.

explanation_profile.meta_pattern_rationale: Conv MR: SciPy solve_bvp adaptively refines its own mesh until residual is below tolerance; the user-supplied num_points only seeds the initial mesh.
